name: off_by_one_range
description: Believes range(n) includes n or starts at 1.

name: counter_vs_sum
description: Confuses the number of loop iterations with the accumulated total.

name: integer_division_float
description: Believes / performs integer division.

name: if_elif_confusion
description: Believes separate if statements are mutually exclusive, or that else runs after any true if.

name: string_methods_in_place
description: Believes string methods modify the string in place.

name: negative_index_confusion
description: Misreads negative list indexes.

name: list_alias_copy
description: Believes assigning a list to a new name copies it.

name: append_vs_extend
description: Confuses append (adds one element) with extend (adds each element).

name: dict_missing_key_none
description: Believes indexing a missing dictionary key returns None or 0.

name: tuple_mutable
description: Believes tuple items can be assigned.

name: return_vs_print
description: Confuses printing a value with returning it.

name: mutable_default_arg
description: Believes a default list argument is created fresh on every call.

name: missing_recursive_return
description: Forgets that a recursive call's value must be returned.

name: assignment_ties_variables
description: Believes that after b = a, changing a also changes b.

name: condition_inverted
description: Takes the else branch when the if condition is true, or the reverse.

name: len_off_by_one
description: Believes len counts one character fewer or more than the string has.

name: index_starts_at_one
description: Believes the first element of a list has index 1.

name: dict_value_vs_key
description: Mixes up keys, values and positions when reading a dictionary.

name: argument_is_result
description: Believes calling a function gives back its argument, not what its body computes.

name: try_always_completes
description: Believes the code in a try block always finishes, or that except runs anyway.

name: method_does_not_change_object
description: Believes a method that changes self.x leaves the object unchanged.

name: init_runs_each_call
description: Believes __init__ runs again every time a method is called.

name: class_attribute_shared
description: Does not realise a list defined in the class body is shared by every object.

name: comprehension_ignores_expression
description: Believes the expression before for in a comprehension is not applied.

name: comprehension_filter_vs_map
description: Reads the if of a comprehension as changing the values, not as a filter.

name: loop_stops_at_first_match
description: Believes a loop stops at the first item that matches.

name: running_max_confusion
description: Believes the largest value is the last one, or the total.

name: string_digits_are_numbers
description: Believes text made of digits is added like numbers.

name: string_repeat_confusion
description: Believes multiplying a string by a number appends the number or repeats each letter.

name: set_keeps_duplicates
description: Believes a set stores a repeated value more than once.

name: len_vs_sum
description: Confuses the number of items in a collection with the total of its values.

name: tuple_assignment_ignored
description: Believes assigning to a tuple item is silently ignored instead of raising an error.

name: recursion_sums_arguments
description: Believes a recursive function adds up its arguments instead of following its return statement.

name: recursion_runs_once
description: Believes the recursive call happens only once, or not at all.

name: fib_index_shift
description: Counts the terms of a recursive sequence from the wrong starting index.

name: except_runs_without_error
description: Believes an except block runs even when nothing was raised.

name: finally_runs_after_return
description: Believes a finally block runs after the returned value has been used.

name: finally_only_on_error
description: Believes a finally block runs only when an exception happened.

name: comprehension_modifies_original
description: Believes a list comprehension changes the list it reads from.

name: attribute_name_vs_value
description: Believes reading an attribute gives its name, not the value stored in it.

name: instance_vs_class_confusion
description: Confuses an object with the class it was made from.

name: object_assignment_copies
description: Believes assigning one object variable to another makes an independent copy.
